title: NATO warships around the expedition
summary: Dennis Asberg tells of NATO warships around the expedition, about 2011 onward at Baltic Sea anomaly, between Sweden and Finland, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> It's NATO. It was French and German and American and British ships around us.

plain: Dennis Asberg, a Swedish treasure hunter, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about his diving expeditions from 2011 onward to a strange object his team found on the floor of the Baltic Sea, between Sweden and Finland. He says warships from NATO, the Western military alliance, gathered around his boat, including French, German, American and British ships. If true, it would suggest that powerful militaries were closely watching what he had found.
